name: browser-use
headline: LeanOS Core - AI Operating System for Founders
short_description: LeanOS Core is an AI operating system for founders, offering 15 skills to run a business with Claude Code. It automates operations tasks, integrates with startup tools, and provides a free core version with a pro upgrade option.
author: BellaBe

sections.overview:
StrategyOS is the entry point of LeanOS, an AI operating system designed for founders and operators. It takes a problem space as input and produces validated strategy and targeting intelligence through a two-agent system: a Strategist that builds candidate hypotheses, and a Gap Definer that validates and identifies market, competitive, segment, and awareness gaps. The system uses web research, compression modeling, and adversarial destruction protocols to classify hypotheses by confidence state (unvalidated, researched, supported, or broken) and evidence tier (public data, synthesized reasoning, or ground truth). StrategyOS outputs a Hypothesis Register documenting problem, segment, unit economics, value proposition, growth architecture, solution design, and GTM plan, along with a Gap Register that surfaces unserved needs and positioning opportunities. The workflow loops until outputs are sell-ready or scale-ready, with human governors resolving escalations.
Validate go-to-market strategy and identify execution gaps before building
Map market gaps and competitive white space for positioning decisions
Test business hypotheses with tiered evidence and kill conditions
Generate targeting intelligence for product and marketing teams

```
Act as my LeanOS Core assistant. I'm a founder of [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. Automate the following tasks for me: [TASKS]. Use [TOOLS] to complete these tasks. Provide a clear plan and execute it.
```
